title: chore: allow guus6457 community publishing
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `guus6457`’s immutable GitHub user ID to the community-model publisher allowlist.
- Keeps the approval stable if the username changes.

Checks:
- Biome 2.3.10
- Allowlist membership and uniqueness assertion
- `git diff --check`

Fixes #13019

gist.headline: A new gardener gets keys
gist.blurb: guus6457 is now cleared to publish community models. The approval is tied to their immutable GitHub ID, because usernames are allowed to wander off and reinvent themselves.
gist.summary: Added guus6457’s immutable GitHub user ID to the community-model publisher allowlist, preserving publishing approval even if their username changes.
gist.impact: guus6457 can now publish community models, with their authorization remaining stable across future GitHub username changes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming a new community gardener into a cozy code garden, handing them a small immutable ID badge and a seed packet labeled “community models.” Use a glowing allowlist clipboard or garden gate to represent approved publishing; include sprouting code-plants to show models being shared.
